## 1.0.0-dev.1 (2026-11-23)

### ✨ New Features

* Add custom audio app patch for Waze ([8e5087f](https://github.com/Endou999/waze-audio-patches/commit/8e5087f94ce01463ff649301ee8520ec71c23011))
* Add GmsCore support patch so Google sign-in works ([2af8de3](https://github.com/Endou999/waze-audio-patches/commit/2af8de3c7fbc35b18bfdba85c5d9b2e9382d9386))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Match Waze's Play Services availability check in GmsCore support ([3a6e4b7](https://github.com/Endou999/waze-audio-patches/commit/3a6e4b7b2c7bc923f163257c524a3044fff87ba9))
* Route Google sign-in to GmsCore instead of the system Credential Manager ([ef04534](https://github.com/Endou999/waze-audio-patches/commit/ef045340f363df0959ad91105d70be382a6b3815))
* Use GmsCore-supported sign-in API for Google sign-in ([ab53e70](https://github.com/Endou999/waze-audio-patches/commit/ab53e70b7c6998461b1ec7e8541874cb33b3b614))
